item.heroicpaths.oblivion_scroll.desc: Resets your class, passive tree and specialization
message.heroicpaths.crypt_king_enraged: The Crypt King flies into a rage!
message.heroicpaths.crypt_king_defeated: The Crypt King has fallen! His treasure is yours.
class.heroicpaths.warrior.desc: Master of weapons and armor. Subclasses: greatsword, shield guardian, axe barbarian, paladin. Resource: stamina.
class.heroicpaths.archer.desc: Marksman. Subclasses: bow ranger and musketeer (harder hits, shorter range, slower reload). Resource: energy.
class.heroicpaths.mage.desc: Master of magic. Subclasses: elementalist, support, summoner, blood mage. Resource: mana (health for the blood mage).
stat.heroicpaths.life_steal: %s%% of melee damage leeched as life
keystone.heroicpaths.blood_rage.desc: Abilities cost health instead of resource (1 health per 5 resource). +20% ability damage.
keystone.heroicpaths.cold_precision.desc: Bonus critical chance is doubled, but critical damage is reduced by 25%.
keystone.heroicpaths.elemental_harmony.d: Fire, water, earth and air bonuses all equal the best of them.
keystone.heroicpaths.iron_will.desc: Spell damage bonuses also apply to melee attacks.
spec.heroicpaths.paladin.desc: Holy warrior: shields for allies, holy smites against the undead and healing.
spec.heroicpaths.guardian.desc: Tank: taunts enemies, soaks damage and reflects it with thorns.
spec.heroicpaths.berserker.desc: Frenzied fighter: trades health for huge damage and executes the wounded.
spec.heroicpaths.sniper.desc: Master of the single shot: piercing arrows and the hunter's mark.
spec.heroicpaths.stormcaller.desc: Hails of arrows and lightning from the sky.
ability.heroicpaths.charge.desc: Dash forward, damaging and knocking back enemies in your path. Grants resistance for 2s.
ability.heroicpaths.whirlwind.desc: Spin and hit every enemy within 4.5 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.war_cry.desc: Strength and resistance for 16s. Strength II from level 30, III from level 60.
ability.heroicpaths.holy_shield.desc: You and allies within 6 blocks gain absorption and resistance for 10s.
ability.heroicpaths.smite.desc: Holy strike on the enemy in front, +50% against undead. Heals you for 30% of damage dealt.
ability.heroicpaths.taunt.desc: Every monster within 10 blocks attacks you. You gain Resistance II for 6s.
ability.heroicpaths.shield_slam.desc: Slam in front of you: damage, heavy knockback and a 2s stun.
ability.heroicpaths.blood_frenzy.desc: Sacrifice 20% health for Strength and Haste II for 10s. Costs no stamina.
ability.heroicpaths.execute.desc: Heavy strike on the enemy in front. Double damage if the target is below 35% health.
ability.heroicpaths.volley.desc: Fire a fan of 5 arrows. Does not consume arrows.
ability.heroicpaths.disengage.desc: Leap backwards and gain speed for 5s.
ability.heroicpaths.arrow_rain.desc: Rain 15 arrows on the spot you are looking at.
ability.heroicpaths.aimed_shot.desc: A devastating arrow that pierces up to 5 enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.hunters_mark.desc: The enemy glows and takes 30% more damage from everyone for 10s.
ability.heroicpaths.poison_arrow.desc: The arrow leaves a poison cloud for 5s that poisons and damages nearby enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.bear_trap.desc: A trap at your feet for 30s that roots and wounds enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.rapid_fire.desc: Three bursts of 3 arrows within a second.
ability.heroicpaths.thunder_arrow.desc: The arrow calls down lightning, damaging every enemy within 3 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.fireball.desc: A fire bolt that ignites the target. Does not ignite blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.frost_nova.desc: A wave of cold: damage and heavy slowness to enemies within 5 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.blink.desc: Teleport 12-20 blocks in the direction you are looking.
ability.heroicpaths.meteor.desc: After a second a meteor strikes your aim point: huge damage and fire within 4 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.flame_wave.desc: A 7-block cone of fire in front of you that burns enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.ice_lance.desc: A fast lance of ice: damage and heavy slowness.
ability.heroicpaths.healing_rain.desc: Rain for 8s that heals you and allies within 6 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.earthquake.desc: Damage, knock up and slow enemies within 6 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning hits an enemy and jumps to 3 more, losing 15% power per jump.
ability.heroicpaths.tornado.desc: A tornado in front of you for 3s pulls enemies in and damages them.
screen.heroicpaths.choose_class_hint: Class and subclass are permanent. Only a Scroll of Oblivion can reset them.
screen.heroicpaths.tree_hint: LMB learn, RMB refund, drag to pan, scroll to zoom
screen.heroicpaths.node_refund: RMB to refund (the point comes back)
screen.heroicpaths.spec_warning: This choice is permanent. Only a Scroll of Oblivion can undo it.
screen.heroicpaths.slot_hint: Pick an ability on the left, then click a slot
screen.heroicpaths.bind_hint: Click an ability, then a slot to put it there
message.heroicpaths.spec_unlocked: Specialization unlocked! Open the menu (K) and go to Specialization.
message.heroicpaths.class_reset: You forgot your path. All points refunded.
message.heroicpaths.no_class: You don't have a class yet
commands.heroicpaths.info: Class: %s (%s), level %s, XP %s/%s, free tree points: %s
dungeon.heroicpaths.crypt.desc: Five floors of clay golems and the Clay Colossus in the arena below.
dungeon.heroicpaths.forge.desc: Scorching halls, blazes and the Flame Tyrant.
dungeon.heroicpaths.frost.desc: Six icy floors of undead (zombies, ghouls, banshees and abominations) and the Frost Lich below.
item.heroicpaths.gate_stone.empty: An empty stone. Take a contract at a guild quest board.
item.heroicpaths.gate_stone.hint: Use on the gate altar in a village plaza
message.heroicpaths.dungeon_completed: This dungeon has already been cleared.
message.heroicpaths.party_full: The party is full: only %s players may enter.
message.heroicpaths.gate_open_for: The gate stays open for %s more seconds.
message.heroicpaths.gate_need_stone: You need a Gate Stone. Take a contract at a guild quest board.
message.heroicpaths.gate_failed: The gate failed to open: the dungeon could not be created.
message.heroicpaths.gate_opened: The gate to %s is open! Party: %s players, enemy health +%s%%
message.heroicpaths.contract_level: This contract requires an average party level of %s.
message.heroicpaths.contract_taken: Contract accepted: %s for %s players. Use the stone on a gate altar.
message.heroicpaths.flame_tyrant_enraged: The Flame Tyrant flies into a rage! The flames grow hotter.
message.heroicpaths.flame_tyrant_defeate: The Flame Tyrant has fallen! The forge grows cold.
message.heroicpaths.frost_lord_enraged: The Frost Lord flies into a rage! A blizzard begins.
message.heroicpaths.frost_lord_defeated: The Frost Lord has fallen! The ice cracks.
screen.heroicpaths.party_hint: Form a party with /party. Each player beyond the first gives enemies +30%% health and +10%% damage
message.heroicpaths.party.already_in_par: You are already in a party. Leave it: /party leave
message.heroicpaths.party.not_leader: Only the party leader can do that.
message.heroicpaths.party.full: The party is full (at most %s players).
message.heroicpaths.party.not_in_party: You are not in a party.
message.heroicpaths.party.not_member: There is no such player in your party.
message.heroicpaths.party.you_were_kicke: You were kicked from the party.
message.heroicpaths.party.solo: You are not in a party (level %s). Create one: /party create, invite: /party invite <name>
message.heroicpaths.access.level: %s requires an average party level of %s. Your party average: %s.
message.heroicpaths.access.not_party: This gate is open for another party.
message.heroicpaths.access.scroll: You need a scroll to enter: %s.
message.heroicpaths.dungeon_rules: The only ways out are defeating the boss (the entrance gate then opens) or dying. Dungeon walls cannot be broken.
message.heroicpaths.gate_items_returned: Nobody entered the gate: the gate stone and scroll were returned.
message.heroicpaths.contract_needs_scrol: To enter you will need a %s. It is crafted from the previous dungeon boss's trophies.
item.heroicpaths.crypt_crown_shard.desc: Crypt King trophy. 3 shards + paper = Blazing Forge scroll.
item.heroicpaths.tyrant_ember_core.desc: Flame Tyrant trophy. 3 cores + paper = Frost Citadel scroll.
item.heroicpaths.frost_heart.desc: Frost Lord trophy. Will be needed for future dungeons.
item.heroicpaths.dungeon_scroll.hint: One scroll per party. Burns only when the party actually enters.
message.heroicpaths.gear.kept: Your gear did not drop but lost %s%% durability. Weapons and armor cannot be repaired.
class.heroicpaths.rogue.desc: Nimble and deadly. Subclasses: crossbowman and dual-dagger duelist. Resource: energy.
class.heroicpaths.hunter.desc: Fights alongside a beast that grows with its master: dog → wolf → boar → bear → owlbear. Own weapons deal 25% less damage. Resource: energy.
subclass.heroicpaths.greatsword.desc: Two-handed weapons (greatsword, warhammer or spear) and wide swings. The off hand must stay free.
subclass.heroicpaths.guardian.desc: Shield and one-handed weapon. Heaviest armor, taunts and shield wall.
subclass.heroicpaths.barbarian.desc: Axe, rage and life steal. Trades health for damage.
subclass.heroicpaths.paladin.desc: Holy warrior: smites the undead, shields and heals allies.
subclass.heroicpaths.elementalist.desc: Fire, water, earth and air: meteors, ice lances, earthquakes and lightning.
subclass.heroicpaths.support.desc: Heals and buffs the party, roots enemies.
subclass.heroicpaths.summoner.desc: Raises skeletons, calls spirit wolves and a stone golem.
subclass.heroicpaths.blood_mage.desc: No mana: spells cost health (1 per 4 cost), but return 15% of their damage as health.
subclass.heroicpaths.ranger.desc: Classic archer: volleys, poison and thunder arrows.
subclass.heroicpaths.musketeer.desc: Musket: less range and rate of fire, much more damage.
subclass.heroicpaths.crossbowman.desc: Heavy and explosive bolts, traps and caltrops.
subclass.heroicpaths.duelist.desc: Two daggers: backstabs, flurries and poisoned blades.
subclass.heroicpaths.beastmaster.desc: Commands an animal companion, heals and empowers it.
core_stat.heroicpaths.dexterity.desc: Each point: +2% ranged weapon damage, +0.3% crit chance, +0.5% attack speed.
core_stat.heroicpaths.constitution.desc: Each point: +1 health and −0.2% damage taken.
core_stat.heroicpaths.intelligence.desc: Each point: +2% spell damage and +2 resource.
core_stat.heroicpaths.wisdom.desc: Each point: +2% healing, +0.1 resource regen, −0.3% cooldowns.
core_stat.heroicpaths.charisma.desc: Each point: +3% companion and summon damage and health; each point above two gives a 1% trade discount.
weapon_req.heroicpaths.two_handed: a two-handed weapon and a free off hand
ability.heroicpaths.cleave.desc: A wide greatsword swing hitting every enemy in front of you.
ability.heroicpaths.leap_slam.desc: Leap forward and slam the ground: area damage and a strong slow.
ability.heroicpaths.shield_wall.desc: 6 seconds: −60% damage taken and an absorption shield, but you move slower.
ability.heroicpaths.axe_throw.desc: Strike an enemy up to 16 blocks away with your axe and slow it.
ability.heroicpaths.lay_on_hands.desc: Heals the ally in front of you (or yourself) for 40% health and cures poison.
ability.heroicpaths.consecration.desc: Holy ground for 6 seconds: hurts enemies (double vs undead) and heals allies.
ability.heroicpaths.ward.desc: Absorption shield on you and nearby party members.
ability.heroicpaths.haste_hymn.desc: You and nearby party members move and strike faster for 15 seconds.
ability.heroicpaths.entangle.desc: Roots hold and hurt nearby enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.purify.desc: Removes harmful effects and fire from the party and heals.
ability.heroicpaths.raise_skeletons.desc: Two skeleton warriors serve you for 40 seconds (three at rank 3). At most four at once.
ability.heroicpaths.spirit_wolves.desc: Two glowing wolves fight for you for 25 seconds (three at rank 3).
ability.heroicpaths.summon_golem.desc: A golem protector serves you for 45 seconds.
ability.heroicpaths.empower_minions.desc: All your nearby creatures gain strength and speed and heal 30%.
ability.heroicpaths.blood_bolt.desc: Strike the enemy in front of you with blood.
ability.heroicpaths.blood_nova.desc: A wave of blood hurts every nearby enemy.
ability.heroicpaths.sanguine_shield.desc: Turns 20% of your current health into an absorption shield twice as large.
ability.heroicpaths.blood_pact.desc: Gives up 30% health: +30% spell power and strength for 12 seconds.
ability.heroicpaths.piercing_shot.desc: A musket shot that pierces every enemy in a line up to 32 blocks.
ability.heroicpaths.grapeshot.desc: A cone of grapeshot with knockback.
ability.heroicpaths.steady_aim.desc: Instantly reloads the musket; the next shot within 10 seconds deals double damage and crits.
ability.heroicpaths.powder_keg.desc: A keg of powder blows up after a second and a half, knocking back and igniting enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.shadow_step.desc: Instantly appear behind an enemy and gain speed.
ability.heroicpaths.smoke_bomb.desc: Blinds and slows nearby enemies; you turn invisible for 4 seconds.
ability.heroicpaths.heavy_bolt.desc: A powerful bolt that knocks back and heavily slows the target.
ability.heroicpaths.caltrops.desc: Scattered spikes for 8 seconds slow and hurt enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.explosive_bolt.desc: A bolt that explodes on impact, hurting everything nearby.
ability.heroicpaths.backstab.desc: A dagger strike, 2.5 times stronger from behind.
ability.heroicpaths.flurry.desc: Four quick dagger strikes on one target.
ability.heroicpaths.poison_blades.desc: For 10 seconds your dagger hits poison.
ability.heroicpaths.fan_of_knives.desc: Knives fly in every direction, hurting nearby enemies.
ability.heroicpaths.call_companion.desc: Summons your animal companion or calls it to you and heals it. A fallen companion returns after a minute.
ability.heroicpaths.sic_em.desc: Your companion charges the enemy in front of you with strength and speed.
ability.heroicpaths.mend_pet.desc: Restores 40% of your companion's health and gives it regeneration.
ability.heroicpaths.pack_howl.desc: You and your companion gain strength and speed; nearby enemies are weakened.
item.heroicpaths.ability_book.hint: Use to learn (spends the book and 1 ability point)
item.heroicpaths.dagger.hint: Fast. With a dagger in the off hand every hit gains half of its damage.
item.heroicpaths.greatsword.hint: Two-handed: half damage if anything is in the off hand.
item.heroicpaths.musket.hint: Damage %s, reload %s s, range about 30 blocks. Fires balls from your inventory.
tooltip.heroicpaths.class_armor_light: Light armor: class armor for archers, rogues and hunters
message.heroicpaths.points_gained_abilit: Gained tree and stat points (%s) and an ability point (%s)!
message.heroicpaths.companion_down: Your companion is still recovering: %s s.
message.heroicpaths.companion_evolved: Your companion has grown: it is now a %s!
message.heroicpaths.companion_fell: Your companion has fallen. It will return in %s seconds.
message.heroicpaths.no_minions: None of your creatures are nearby.
screen.heroicpaths.choose_subclass_hint: Hover a subclass to see its abilities and bonuses.
screen.heroicpaths.subclass_warning: Permanent choice: classes cannot be mixed.
screen.heroicpaths.rank_up_hint: Raise to rank %s for 1 ability point: +25% power and −10% cooldown
screen.heroicpaths.needs_book: Needs an ability book (from level %s): found in dungeons and sold by mentors.
screen.heroicpaths.bind_selected: Now click the slot for this ability
screen.heroicpaths.books_hint: New abilities come from books: use the book. An ability point buys a book or a rank (+).
item.heroicpaths.focus.wand_hint: Wand: a mage's spell damage depends on its spell power. Leaves the off hand free.
item.heroicpaths.focus.staff_hint: Staff: stronger than a wand but two-handed — half power with anything in the off hand.
message.heroicpaths.mage_wand_given: You received an Apprentice Wand. Your spell damage depends on the wand or staff in your hand.
screen.heroicpaths.settings.hint: Menu and ability keys are in the Heroic Paths section of the controls list. These settings also open from the mod list.
station.heroicpaths.forge: Smithing Forge: metal weapons, tools and armor
station.heroicpaths.tannery: Tanning Vat: leather, wood and stone, bows, crossbows, shields
station.heroicpaths.loom: Tailoring Loom: cloth and mage robes
station.heroicpaths.rune_table: Rune Table: runes, wands and staves
screen.heroicpaths.station.hint: Click a recipe to craft it; Shift+click crafts as many as your materials allow. Recipes above your craft rank are locked.
screen.heroicpaths.station.empty: This station has no recipes yet
tooltip.heroicpaths.set_grade_hint: The set bonus uses the lowest grade of the four pieces
weapon_type.heroicpaths.crushing.effect: 15% chance to stun, +25% damage to skeletons and golems
tooltip.heroicpaths.one_handed: One-handed: a second one-handed weapon in the other hand adds half its damage and its effect
tooltip.heroicpaths.two_handed: Two-handed: held in both hands, the off hand is locked
tooltip.heroicpaths.paired: Paired: in the main hand it is wielded with a matching second dagger, the off hand is locked
message.heroicpaths.paired_offhand: Daggers come in pairs: the off-hand item went to your inventory
message.heroicpaths.two_handed_offhand: A two-handed weapon needs both hands: the off-hand item went to your inventory
message.heroicpaths.two_handed_swap: A two-handed weapon cannot go in the off hand
tooltip.heroicpaths.offhand_locked: The off hand is busy: a two-handed weapon or the second dagger
death.attack.heroicpaths.bleeding.player: %1$s bled out after being wounded by %2$s
keystone.heroicpaths.ambush.desc: +40% damage to targets at nearly full health, −10% max health.
keystone.heroicpaths.pack_bond.desc: +40% companion damage and health, −20% to your own damage.
keystone.heroicpaths.vital_surge.desc: Every kill heals 8% of your health, −10% to all damage.
keystone.heroicpaths.arcane_shield.desc: 30% of damage taken is paid with your resource (2 per point of damage).
class.heroicpaths.warrior.trait.desc: melee hits restore 3 stamina, and below 35% health the warrior takes 20% less damage.
class.heroicpaths.archer.trait.desc: arrows deal 2% more damage for every block beyond 8 (up to +30%).
class.heroicpaths.mage.trait.desc: a spell of a different element than the previous one deals 20% more damage — alternate fire, water, earth and air.
class.heroicpaths.rogue.trait.desc: melee hits from behind the target deal 35% more damage.
class.heroicpaths.hunter.trait.desc: while the companion is alive and within 24 blocks, the hunter takes 15% less damage.
message.heroicpaths.tree_rebuilt: The passive tree was rebuilt for five classes: your tree points were refunded, spend them again in the menu (K).
message.heroicpaths.mana_shield_blood: Mana Shield does not work while abilities cost health
ability.heroicpaths.sunder.desc: A heavy blow to the target in front: damage, a 1.5 s stun and a slow.
ability.heroicpaths.battle_banner.desc: A banner for 10 s: you and your party within 6 blocks of it gain strength and resistance.
ability.heroicpaths.last_stand.desc: For 6 s your health cannot drop below 1; afterwards you heal 20% of your health.
ability.heroicpaths.concussive_shot.desc: An arrow that knocks the target back, stuns it for 1.5 s and slows it.
ability.heroicpaths.net_shot.desc: An arrow with a net: enemies within 2.5 blocks of the hit are rooted and weakened for 4 s.
ability.heroicpaths.eagle_eye.desc: 10 s: +25% crit chance, night vision, enemies within 32 blocks glow.
ability.heroicpaths.mana_shield.desc: For 10 s, 60% of damage taken is paid with mana (2 mana per point of damage).
ability.heroicpaths.blizzard.desc: A blizzard where you look: 8 waves of cold on enemies within 4 blocks, slowing and freezing them.
ability.heroicpaths.eviscerate.desc: Opens wounds: +60% damage per bleeding level of the target (consumes bleeding). Without bleeding, causes it.
ability.heroicpaths.vanish.desc: Invisibility for 6 s, enemies lose track of you; your next melee hit deals 60% more.
ability.heroicpaths.feral_rage.desc: Your companion gains strength, speed and resistance for 10 s and heals 25%.
ability.heroicpaths.tracking.desc: All enemies within 40 blocks glow for 15 s; the nearest is marked and takes +30% damage.
ability.heroicpaths.pounce.desc: Your companion leaps to the target in front of you, strikes it and stuns it for 1.5 s.
order_type.heroicpaths.boss.desc: Slay the boss in its lair: counts for every player near the boss and their parties. Turn it in to the herald or at any order board.
screen.heroicpaths.bounty_hint: The guild pays for the heads of dungeon lords: double rewards and soul stones. Bounties refresh every in-game day.
order_type.heroicpaths.hunt.desc: Slay the creatures: kills by you, your companion and your party count.
order_type.heroicpaths.delivery.desc: Bring the items and turn the order in at a board; they are taken from your inventory.
order_type.heroicpaths.gather.desc: Mine the blocks: blocks broken by you and your party count.
order_type.heroicpaths.dungeon.desc: Defeat the dungeon boss: counts for everyone who entered and their parties.
screen.heroicpaths.order_hint: Orders refresh every in-game day. Kills, mining and dungeon clears by any party member count for everyone who took such an order.
screen.heroicpaths.order_none: No orders — take one on the left
screen.heroicpaths.order_party_hint: Progress made by your party members counts too.
screen.heroicpaths.settings.plates: Mob level plates: up to %s blocks
message.heroicpaths.order_already: You already took this order today
message.heroicpaths.order_full: You cannot hold more than %s orders
message.heroicpaths.order_not_done: The order is not done yet: %s/%s
message.heroicpaths.order_done: Order "%s" turned in: +%s XP and %s emeralds
message.heroicpaths.order_ready: Order "%s" is done — turn it in at a guild order board
item.heroicpaths.profession_manual.maste: Only one craft can rise above Artisan: it becomes your mastery
item.heroicpaths.hand_crossbow.pair: One-handed: a pair reloads together and fires a volley
item.heroicpaths.oblivion_scroll.mastery: Shift+use: forget your craft mastery (your class stays)
message.heroicpaths.craft_rank_ready: %s: enough XP for %s — read %s (sold by master villagers)
message.heroicpaths.manual_mastery_taken: Mastery already chosen: %s. Reset it with Shift+use of an Oblivion Scroll
message.heroicpaths.craft_mastery: %s: %s! This craft is now your mastery
message.heroicpaths.mastery_reset: Mastery of %s forgotten: the craft drops to Artisan
screen.heroicpaths.craft.capped: cap reached: your mastery is another craft
screen.heroicpaths.craft.no_mastery: No mastery yet. The first craft raised to Expert becomes your mastery: only it can reach Master, the others stop at Artisan.
screen.heroicpaths.craft.mastery: Mastery: %s. Other crafts stop at Artisan. Reset with Shift+use of an Oblivion Scroll.
screen.heroicpaths.craft.stations.blacks: Forge: all metal weapons, tools and armor (iron, gold, diamond, steel, damascus) and warrior plate. Weapons, armor and tools cannot be made in a crafting table.
screen.heroicpaths.craft.stations.carpen: Tanning vat and loom: wooden and stone tools and swords, bows, crossbows, hand crossbows, shields, leather armor, robes.
screen.heroicpaths.craft.stations.runecr: Rune table: runes, wands and staves, and rune enchanting — the only way to enchant weapons and armor.
screen.heroicpaths.rune.hint: Hold a weapon or armor in your main hand. Each enchantment costs one rune of its element per level plus experience levels. Your Rune Enchanter rank caps the level, the item's rarity caps how many enchantments it holds.
screen.heroicpaths.rune.no_item: Hold a weapon, armor or tool in your main hand
screen.heroicpaths.rune.lock_slots: No room: this rarity holds %s enchantments
screen.heroicpaths.craft.hover: Hover over a craft to see its stations
item.heroicpaths.soul_stone.desc: Absorbs the souls of mobs killed by you and your creatures while in your inventory. Without souls no crafted item becomes Rare or better.
item.heroicpaths.relic_spark.desc: Raises a legendary item to a relic at a Relic Altar
message.heroicpaths.soul_stone_short: Not enough souls: rolled %s but got %s. Fill a soul stone of the right tier.
message.heroicpaths.soul_stone_none: No charged soul stone: rolled %s but got %s.
message.heroicpaths.crafted_rarity_souls: You crafted a %s item! The soul stone gave %s souls
message.heroicpaths.relic_need_legendary: Only a legendary item can become a relic
message.heroicpaths.relic_need_spark: You need a Relic Spark — dungeon bosses drop them
message.heroicpaths.relic_hint: Use a legendary item here: a Relic Spark and %s levels turn it into a relic
message.heroicpaths.relic_spark_found: The boss left a Relic Spark!
tooltip.heroicpaths.armor_guardian: Guardian: +%s%% damage reduction per heavy piece
screen.heroicpaths.armor.no_stealth: No Vanish and no backstab in heavy armor
message.heroicpaths.armor_blocks_spell: You cannot cast %s in such heavy armor
message.heroicpaths.armor_blocks_vanish: You cannot vanish in heavy armor
dungeon.heroicpaths.spider_lair.desc: Webbed burrows, spiders and the Spider Queen.
dungeon.heroicpaths.sunken_temple.desc: Prismarine halls, the drowned and the Drowned Prophet.
dungeon.heroicpaths.necropolis.desc: A city of the dead: wither skeletons, husks and the Lich.
message.heroicpaths.spider_queen_enraged: The Spider Queen is enraged! Spiders pour from the burrows.
message.heroicpaths.spider_queen_defeate: The Spider Queen is defeated! The webs fall.
message.heroicpaths.drowned_prophet_enra: The Drowned Prophet is enraged! The tide is rising.
message.heroicpaths.drowned_prophet_defe: The Drowned Prophet is defeated! The waters recede.
message.heroicpaths.lich_enraged: The Lich is enraged! The dead rise from their graves.
message.heroicpaths.lich_defeated: The Lich is defeated! Its phylactery cracks.
item.heroicpaths.broodmother_fang.desc: Trophy of the Spider Queen. 3 fangs + paper = Sunken Temple scroll.
item.heroicpaths.tide_pearl.desc: Trophy of the Drowned Prophet. 3 pearls + paper = Necropolis scroll.
item.heroicpaths.lich_phylactery.desc: Trophy of the Lich — the greatest trophy of the depths.
message.heroicpaths.gate_sealed: The dungeon gate is sealed for %s more min.
tooltip.heroicpaths.shield.buckler: Small and light: keeps quick strikes quick
tooltip.heroicpaths.shield.heater: A knightly shield: armor and footing
tooltip.heroicpaths.shield.kite: Large and heavy: the most armor, but slows you
message.heroicpaths.focus_mage_only: Only a mage can shoot from a wand or staff
item.heroicpaths.focus.bolt: Hold right click: %s — 5%% mana, seeks enemies
item.heroicpaths.focus.bolt.storm: storm bolt, arcs to another enemy

message.heroicpaths.dungeon_gate_opened: The gate at the dungeon entrance has opened — go back to it to return home.

message.heroicpaths.clay_colossus_phase2: The Clay Colossus sheds its breastplate and lower arms! It grows faster and angrier and starts hurling boulders.
message.heroicpaths.clay_colossus_phase3: The Colossus loses its helmet and another pair of arms, its core glows red-hot! No armor left, but it rages and leaps at its foes.
message.heroicpaths.clay_colossus_defeat: The Clay Colossus crumbles! The way home is open.
message.heroicpaths.frost_lich_phase2: The Lich gathers power! He starts casting: frost novas, chain frost, banshees and frozen archers.
message.heroicpaths.frost_lich_phase3: The Lich is wrapped in a blizzard! Hailstorms, a freezing aura and blinks away: frost magic at full strength.
message.heroicpaths.frost_lich_defeated: The Frost Lich crumbles into snow dust! The way home is open.
